data.title: Ant on a cube
data.statement:
You are an ant on the surface of a regular cube with a side length of 1. You can walk freely on the cube's surface.

You are given a tour of [[n]] corner numbers. You start at the first corner of the tour and visit all remaining corners of the tour in the tour's sequence. The tour stops at the last tour corner. A tour may or may not start and end at the same corner. A tour can also visit the same corners multiple times.

The cube's corners are numbered as depicted here:
```
    8----------7
   /|         /|
  / |        / |
 /  |       /  |
4---+------3   |
|   5------|---6
|  /       |  /
| /        | /
|/         |/
1----------2
```

Or if you prefer an image:  https://postimg.cc/PpNvDXjt

Find and output the shortest total length of the tour. The length has to be rounded to 3 decimal digits.

lastVersion.statementHTML:
Goal

You are an ant on the surface of a regular cube with a side length of 1. You can walk freely on the cube's surface.

You are given a tour of n corner numbers. You start at the first corner of the tour and visit all remaining corners of the tour in the tour's sequence. The tour stops at the last tour corner. A tour may or may not start and end at the same corner. A tour can also visit the same corners multiple times.

The cube's corners are numbered as depicted here:

    8----------7
   /|         /|
  / |        / |
 /  |       /  |
4---+------3   |
|   5------|---6
|  /       |  /
| /        | /
|/         |/
1----------2


Or if you prefer an image:  https://postimg.cc/PpNvDXjt

Find and output the shortest total length of the tour. The length has to be rounded to 3 decimal digits.




   

      
Input

      
Line 1: The tour string containing the n corner numbers (each between 1 and 8)

   

   

      
Output

      
Line 1: The shortest path length of the tour, rounded to 3 decimal places

   

   

      
Constraints

      
0 < n <= 100

   

   

      
Example

      

         

            
Input

            
12

         

         

            
Output

            
1.000
